name: teamwork-tasks-from-dnr
description: Generate Teamwork.com import-ready task plan (XLSX + Markdown) from a 'Detailný návrh riešenia' (DNR) document. LLM-powered extraction of tasklists, business-friendly task names, acceptance criteria, and technical plans. Multi-language (sk/en/cs). Since 1.3.0 a contract-first flow detects the repo (backend/frontend/standalone) and, in a Laravel backend repo, generates an OpenAPI 3.1 contract skeleton + data-model from the DNR under docs/contracts/<feature>/, adds a 'Definovať API kontrakt' predecessor task, and links every API task to the contract so backend and frontend can run in parallel.
